sloka: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा त्वरमाणो विभीषणः ।संस्कारेणानुरूपेण योजयामास रावणम् ।। ६.११४.१०३ ।।
transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā tvaramāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।saṁskāreṇānurūpeṇa yojayāmāsa rāvaṇam ।। 6.114.103 ।।

translations.english: "Ten headed Ravana being so (knower of righteousness), he deserves your performance of his last rites as per tradition and righteously You will attain fame by doing this deed."
